name: GetSymbolsOverview
purpose: Returns a high-level overview of all symbols (classes, functions, types) defined in a file.

name: FindSymbol
purpose: Finds a specific symbol by name path and returns its definition, location, and optionally its source body.

name: FindReferencingSymbols
purpose: Lists all symbols that reference a given symbol, with surrounding code snippets.

name: glob
purpose: Finds files whose paths match a glob pattern, sorted by modification time.

name: grep
purpose: Searches file contents with a regex pattern and returns matching lines with their file paths and line numbers.

name: read_file
purpose: Reads the content of a file, with optional line ranges for efficient partial reads.

name: read_xlsx
purpose: Reads and summarises an Excel (.xlsx) workbook, returning sheet structure and sample rows.

name: write_file
purpose: Creates a new file or completely overwrites an existing file with the given content.

name: apply_diff
purpose: Applies precise, targeted search-and-replace edits to a file using SEARCH/REPLACE blocks.

name: insert_content
purpose: Inserts new lines of content into a file at a specified line number without modifying existing content.

name: search_and_replace
purpose: Finds and replaces specific text strings or regex patterns within a file.

name: list_files
purpose: Lists files and directories within a given directory, optionally recursively.

name: execute_command
purpose: Executes a CLI command in a bash shell, returning stdout and stderr.

name: update_todo_list
purpose: Replaces the current task checklist with an updated list, tracking progress through multi-step tasks.

name: ask_followup_question
purpose: Asks the user a clarifying question with optional suggested answers when additional information is needed.

name: switch_mode
purpose: Switches the active Bob mode (persona) for the current session.

name: use_skill
purpose: Activates a named Bob skill, loading its full instructions into the context window.

name: search_bob_docs
purpose: Searches Bob documentation using semantic search to find information about features and configuration.

name: spawn_subagent
purpose: Spawns a new independent subagent to execute a task in parallel.

name: start_subtask
purpose: Starts a subtask within the current agent session for delegated work.

name: start_workflow
purpose: Starts a predefined multi-step workflow by its identifier.

name: create_html_artifact
purpose: Creates an HTML artifact rendered inline in the chat as a rich visual output.

name: create_chart
purpose: Creates a chart artifact rendered inline in the chat from structured data.
